name: Volnewmer

lead: VolNewMer (VNM) is a monopolar radiofrequency device from Korea that delivers continuous 115-watt, 6.78 MHz energy to heat the skin and deeper tissue. Clinics use it as a non-surgical option to tighten skin, lift the lower face and smooth fine wrinkles.

Two 2024 studies in Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery Global Open examined it. In 30 Korean women, 3D scanning measured lifting of roughly 1.5 to 2.7 mm across areas of the face and neck right after treatment. In 45 participants, skin roughness fell by about 28 percent immediately and 26 percent at one month.

paras: A clinician moves the handpiece over the face under continuous cooling, sometimes with a topical medium applied. Published work describes sessions assessed immediately and at follow-up around one month.

The studies describe it as non-invasive, with common radiofrequency effects such as warmth and temporary redness. Heat-based devices carry a risk of burns if used improperly, so treatment is by trained clinicians.

chain: Radiofrequency heats skin and deeper tissue
Tighter skin, lifted cheeks and jawline, smoother fine lines
angle.text: Treatments aim at a modest lift and smoother skin texture without surgery. Published measurements show changes of a millimetre or two in facial position and a reduction in measured roughness.

lead: VolNewMer (VNM) is a continuous-radiation monopolar radiofrequency device operating at 6.78 MHz and 115 W, used in aesthetic clinics for non-invasive facelift-type treatments [1][2].

In a study of 30 Korean women, 3D scanning showed immediate lifting of 1.88 mm in the mid-cheek, 1.79 mm in the lower face, 1.62 mm at the lateral orbital rim, 1.46 mm in the forehead and 2.66 mm in the neck, with sustained improvement in the mid-cheeks and lower face and improved Global Aesthetic Improvement Scale ratings for texture, tightening and lifting [1]. The protocol included cooling and stem cell media application [1].

A second study of 50 participants (45 completing) found skin roughness fell from 16.71 to 11.88 arbitrary units immediately (28.42 percent) and to 12.33 at one month (26.23 percent), with 16 participants showing even greater improvement at one month [2].

paras: The device delivers continuous monopolar RF energy with water cooling to protect the skin surface while heating deeper layers [2]. Study protocols specified energy levels, cooling techniques and, in one, stem cell media application [1].

Three-dimensional scanning showed lifting of about 1.5 to 2.7 mm across five aesthetic units immediately after treatment, and the mid-cheek and lower face improvements were sustained [1]. Roughness analysis showed improvement that was largely maintained at one month [2].

A 30-woman cohort assessed lifting with a 3D scanner and Global Aesthetic Improvement Scale surveys [1]. A 50-participant study (45 completers) used standardized 3D imaging to measure roughness immediately and at one month [2]. Both are 2024 reports with short follow-up.

timeline.event: Two studies of the 115 W 6.78 MHz VolNewMer device are published in Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery Global Open [1][2].
